description: Test your understanding of the course mission, learning roadmap, and study habits recommended in the opening episode.

questions.question: What is the main goal of this Namaste AI series?
options: Only watch videos without any practice
Learn AI deeply and build real products
Memorize every AI research paper by heart
questions.explanation: The series focuses on understanding AI properly and using it to solve real problems — not shallow tool usage. You should be able to build products, not just copy-paste from ChatGPT.

questions.question: Which study habit does Ashu recommend for learning?
options: Binge-watch 5 hours straight without breaks
Pomodoro with breaks (~50 min max, then 5–10 min rest)
Skip notes and only read headlines
questions.explanation: Short focused sessions with breaks help you retain more than marathon binge sessions. Use Pomodoro extensions and take at least a 5–10 minute break after ~50 minutes of learning.

questions.question: What comes right after Intro in the course roadmap?
options: RAG
LLM
MCP
questions.explanation: The path starts Intro → LLM → Prompting → AI for SDEs → AI Tools → RAG → AI Agents → MCP → AI Engineering → Projects. Follow this order for best results.

questions.question: Do you need expert-level coding skills to follow this series?
options: Yes, you must be an expert in Python only
Basic coding in JavaScript or Python is enough
No coding knowledge is needed at all
questions.explanation: Basic coding knowledge in JavaScript or Python is sufficient. There's no hard language lock — you can use AI to translate code between languages if needed.

questions.question: What should you do when you don't understand a topic?
options: Skip it and move to the next topic immediately
Rewatch the video 2–3 times and stay patient
Wait for someone else to explain it to you
questions.explanation: Patience matters. Rewatch tough parts 2–3 times, make notes, help others in the community, and experiment on your own. Slow and steady beats rushing.

questions.question: Why should you stay active on social media while learning?
options: To show off without actually learning
To share your journey, build community, and reach recruiters
Social media has nothing to do with learning AI
questions.explanation: Posting your learning journey helps you stay accountable, builds community, and can reach recruiters. Create friends, take challenges, and learn from others who are on the same path.

questions.question: What mindset does the series encourage for long-term learning?
options: Learn everything in one week or give up
Keep taking action consistently — results follow over time
Only learn when someone forces you to
questions.explanation: Learning AI is a long game. Do Karm — keep showing up, stay curious, explore on your own, and trust that consistency will pay off. All comes on time if you keep taking action.
